messages.守備で「時間貸与」を得て、クイックとマッチ威力増加で序盤からマッチを制するタンク: A tank that gains Borrow Time through defense and wins early clashes with Haste and Clash Power Up. Stack Tremor, then apply Time Moratorium with S3 to release stored damage as Sloth damage; Tremor - Chain also lowers the enemy's Clash Power.
messages.時間貸与: 守備「時間を引き寄せようぞ」を構えると、時間貸与状態でなければ、戦闘: **Borrowed Time**: When she sets up the Defense skill I Shall Summon the Time while not in Borrowed Time, its Combat Start effect grants 4 Borrowed Time at Turn End, once per turn; it cannot be regained while active. If she ends a turn with 2 or more Count, she gains Haste, Clash Power Up, and Fragile equal to (Count − 1) next turn. If she ends a turn with 1 Count, she gains (Potency − 1)×2 Bind next turn. If the Bind she would gain next turn exceeds her Haste, Borrowed Time ends and she is staggered. For the 3 turns after using her Defense skill, Haste, Clash Power Up, and Fragile decrease 3→2→1, and on the turn after that she receives 6 Bind.
messages.守備で振動付与: 守備を使ったターンは、敵からダメージを受けると次のターンに振動: **Tremor from her Defense skill**: On the turn she uses her Defense skill, taking damage from enemies inflicts 2/3 Tremor next turn, 2/6 times per turn.
messages.振動で強化: 各攻撃スキルは対象の振動が6以上なら/につき、マッチ威力+1(最大: **Tremor bonuses**: Each attack skill gains +1 Clash Power if/for every 6 Tremor on the target, up to 2. S2 T Corp. Accelerated Amputator spends up to 3 of the target's Tremor with Coin Ⅰ to inflict (Tremor spent − 1) Bind next turn. Coin Ⅲ triggers Tremor Burst if this skill's Coin effects spent Tremor.
messages.S3「そこ、停まりたまえ！」の時間猶予: Ⅳコインの的中時、対象の振動が10以上: **S3 I Command Thee, Halt!'s Time Moratorium**: On Coin Ⅳ hit, if the target has at least 10 Tremor, spends 10 Tremor to inflict 2 Time Moratorium; it does not spend Tremor while she is in Borrowed Time. During Time Moratorium, the target takes no damage and stores it instead. At Combat End at Count 1, it takes (100 + Potency×15)% of the stored amount as Sloth damage. Because the damage becomes Sloth, the enemy's Sloth resistance changes the effect greatly.
messages.振動-鎖: S3のⅣコインの的中時、対象の速度が自分より低ければ振動-鎖へ振幅変: **Tremor - Chain**: On Coin Ⅳ hit of S3, if the target is slower than her, it performs Amplitude Conversion into Tremor - Chain. −1 Clash Power on the target for every 10 Tremor Potency, up to 3.
messages.バトルパッシブ「ゴールデンタイム-領収」(怠惰×5・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): タ: **Combat passive — Golden Time - Extracting (5 Sloth Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: If her HP is between 10% and 20% at Turn End, she recovers 80% HP and recovers from Stagger, once per battle. When Borrowed Time ends, one of her skill slots gains 8 Aggro next turn.
messages.強い敵には初手で守備を構えて時間貸与を得て、強化されている間にマッチを取る。安定: Against strong enemies, open with her Defense skill to gain Borrowed Time, and take Clashes while she is buffed. Against opponents she can beat reliably, she can skip the Defense skill, which spends a turn without dealing damage. Once Tremor is stacked, apply Time Moratorium with S3, but not against enemies she can finish off or enemies that resist Sloth, because damage stops landing during Time Moratorium. Against enemies slower than her, use Coin Ⅳ of S3 to convert into Tremor - Chain and lower their Clash Power. She tends to spend Tremor Count, so have allies who handle Tremor maintain it.
